name: session_continuity_requires_previous_session
description: CASE_01 requires a multi-session journey with prior customer context available.

name: cross_channel_case_requires_multiple_channels
description: CASE_02 requires a journey across more than one channel or platform and a linkable customer identity.

name: handoff_case_requires_handler_transition
description: CASE_03 requires responsibility to move between handlers within or across sessions.

name: continuous_improvement_requires_evaluation_history
description: CASE_04 requires completed interactions and evaluation or feedback history so before-and-after improvement can be measured.

name: post_purchase_persona_requires_prior_purchase
description: P03 represents a customer calling back about exchange or complaint, so a prior purchase must exist.

name: third_contact_persona_requires_three_sessions
description: P05 represents a customer contacting for the third time, so the journey must contain at least three sessions.

name: change_of_mind_requires_prior_value
description: D01 requires a previously established decision or value that the customer can later change.

name: conflicting_information_requires_previous_fact
description: D02 requires a prior fact so the later customer statement can conflict with it.

name: expired_promotion_requires_prior_promotion
description: D03 requires a previously available promotion and a later session after that promotion expires.

name: outside_documentation_requires_missing_authoritative_answer
description: D04 is valid only when the requested answer is absent from the authoritative business sources.
